title: Modification of detailed site development plan
text:
20.04.170 Modification of detailed site development plan.
Where the development is for apartments or mixed-use residential development that meet all minimum requirements set forth in Chapter 20.12 (Density and Dimensional Standards) and Section 20.10.363, approval of minor modifications shall not be required.
(Ord. 16653 § 2 (part), 2007)
(Ord. No. 019815, § 2, 11-18-2025)
Article IV. Master Zoning Plan Approval Process
